Quoted from SunnyMarch post a few weeks ago. Their website seems to be down right now, so I copied what they posted about the We Are Colony website:

We Are Colony is a new video-on-demand platform that puts fans of independent cinema in touch with behind the scenes content from great independent films. We have put together what we have in the way of extra material, including a copy of the shooting script, stills from the shoot and over an hour of behind the scenes footage and interviews. We Are Colony is still in the private invitation stage, but we have arranged a code that will allow you early access to the site before its public launch. Go to www.wearecolony.com to sign-up, type in the code “LittleFavour” when registering and you will be given priority access to the site. Once you have entered your details you will receive a private invitation by e-mail (you may need to check your junk folder for this e-mail) and then you can register with the site. As this is the invitation stage of the site it may take a day or two to receive your invitation. If you have any questions or need assistance with the process please contact We Are Colony directly through their FB and Twitter pages.

I went through the process myself a few weeks ago and it's pretty straight forward. There are things from both Little Favour and Third Star. It'll let you browse for a bit, then there's a nominal fee for unlimited access to the extras from both movies. A great way especially to support Benedict, Little Favour, and SunnyMarch, which is a fledgling independent movie studio that Benedict helped found with some friends of his.
